sloka: कार्यार्थिनां विमर्दो हि राज्ञां दोषाय कल्पते ।तच्छीघ्रं दर्शनं मह्यमभिवर्तन्तु कार्यिणः ।। ७.५३.२५ ॥
transliteration: kāryārthināṁ vimardo hi rājñāṁ doṣāya kalpate ।tacchīghraṁ darśanaṁ mahyamabhivartantu kāryiṇaḥ ।। 7.53.25 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, the crowding of petitioners leads to harm for kings; therefore, let the petitioners quickly approach me for an audience.
